Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
Found no actual ruling on this one, and had a disagreement in a game yesterday:

- Does Revelation of Wrath take environmental damage into account (for example do the damage from Carrion Crows count as damage "the opposing minion inflicted") ?

- Does Revelation of Wrath allow to take control of the opposing minion if it places enough corruption counters on it ?

I found no Rules Director confirmation on either of them.

Thanks in advance !

NB: Thanks for refraining to answer without a Rules Director ruling - opinions have already been voiced on the subject  here and  here , but neither Pascal nor Ankha were Rules Director at the time of these posts.

Revelation of Wrath

Only usable at the end of a round in which the opposing minion inflicted 2 or more damage or any aggravated damage (even if it was prevented). Put a corruption counter on the opposing minion. A vampire can play only one Revelation of Wrath each round.

As above, and place an additional corruption counter if the opposing minion inflicted 3 or more damage or 2 or more aggravated damage this round.

Carrion Crows

Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Carrion Crows each combat.

The opposing minion takes 1R environmental damage each round this combat during normal strike resolution.

As above, but for 2R environmental damage.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> lip wrote:
> - Does Revelation of Wrath take environmental damage into account (for example do the damage from Carrion Crows count as damage "the opposing minion inflicted") ?
>
No. Environmental damage is not inflicted by the minion, per definition.

"Environmental damage: Any damage not inflicted by a minion either as a strike, or by an explicit effect (“this minion inflicts...”) is environmental. Environmental damage can have no source (such as the damage inflicted by a Carrion Crows) or a non-minion source
(such as the damage inflicted by a retainer)."

> lip wrote:
> - Does Revelation of Wrath allow to take control of the opposing minion if it places enough corruption counters on it ?
>
No, it requires explicit cardtext to do so.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body: Can vampire play Revelation of Wrath even if him go torpor or be burned after strike resolve?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Since both Taste and Disarm explicitly state "Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor" and Revelation of Wrath does not, it is possible.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Can vampire play Revelation of Wrath even if him go torpor
>
Yes.

> beslin wrote:
> or be burned after strike resolve?
>
A vampire who is no longer in play cannot play cards.

EDIT: for clarity, a vampire who is "being burned" can play Revelation of Wrath at the end of the round, since it lacks the "Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor." clause.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
